source_entity: 4HA / Policy LPA11 - Bold Forest Garden Village
evidence_slice: St Helens Borough Council states that the Bold Forest Garden Village Masterplan was adopted on 21 January 2026 in line with site allocation 4HA and Policy LPA11; the 128-hectare site aims to deliver around 3,000 homes, including 30% affordable housing, with a new primary school, on-site health care provision and strategic open space.
